title: My Weekend Hobbies
text:
I like sports. On Saturday I play football with my friends. We play in the park near my house. It is fun.

On Sunday I read books. My favorite book is about animals. I read it in the afternoon. I like hobbies that are quiet.

questions.text: What sport does the writer play on Saturday?
When does the writer read books?
What does the writer probably enjoy most about Saturday?
What kind of person is the writer most likely to be?
options: Someone who enjoys both active and quiet activities

vocabulary.definition: a sport played with a ball by two teams of eleven players
a public green area where people can play and relax
the one that you like more than all others

paragraph_translations: Me gustan los deportes. El sábado juego al fútbol con mis amigos. Jugamos en el parque cerca de mi casa. Es divertido.
El domingo leo libros. Mi libro favorito es sobre animales. Lo leo por la tarde. Me gustan los pasatiempos tranquilos.
